contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C MAXIM[.]NVS P F AVG ; R/ GENIO POPVLI ROMANI

A complete, Roman, copper-alloy nummus of Maximian (294-307), dating to c. AD 300-303 (Reece period 15), RIC VI, p. 124, no. 6b. Obverse description: Right-facing, laureate with cuirass visible on bust. Obverse inscription: IMP C MAXIM[.]NVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Genius standing facing left, holding patera and cornucopia. Reverse inscription: GENIO POPVLI ROMANI. Reverse mintmark: - -//-. Diameter: 27.19 mm; Thickness: 2.34 mm; Weight: 9.26g
